join_order.notes: Use lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped index; probe keys sorted by o_orderkey so access is sequential
25-entry direct array nationkey→n_name, resolved during late materialization
Only top-20 customers need lookup via customer_c_custkey_lookup index

phase1_load_nation.description: Load 25-row nation table, build nationkey→n_name direct array

phase2_scan_orders.description: Read zonemap, identify qualifying blocks where date range [8674,8766) overlaps. Parallel scan qualifying blocks, filter o_orderdate. Two-pass parallel scatter: count qualifying per thread, prefix sum, scatter (o_orderkey, o_custkey) pairs into compact array.

phase3_probe_lineitem.description: Partition qualifying orders across threads by range. For each orderkey, lookup lineitem_l_orderkey_grouped index to get (start, count). Read l_returnflag at those positions, filter == 82. For matches, read l_extendedprice and l_discount, compute extendedprice*(1-discount). Accumulate into per-thread hash map keyed by c_custkey (from qualifying orders array).
phase3_probe_lineitem.madvise: MADV_SEQUENTIAL on l_returnflag, l_extendedprice, l_discount columns since orderkeys are sorted

phase4_merge_aggregate.description: Merge per-thread hash maps into single map. Use partial_sort or priority queue to find top-20 by revenue DESC.

phase5_materialize.description: For top-20 custkeys only: use customer_c_custkey_lookup to get row_id, read c_name, c_acctbal, c_address, c_phone, c_comment, c_nationkey. Lookup n_name from nation direct array.
